item.title: SPD officers stable following possible fentanyl exposure
item.description: Two Shreveport Police officers were transported for medical evaluation Wednesday, Feb. 11, following a possible fentanyl exposure while serving an arrest warrant. According to authorities, officers were executing a warrant in the 2000 block of Grimmett Drive at a local apartment complex when they came into contact with a suspected substance believed to be fentanyl. … Continue reading SPD officers stable following possible fentanyl exposure

item.title: Christopher Hill named principal of Huntington High School
item.description: Huntington High School has officially welcomed Christopher Hill as its new principal. Hill most recently served as assistant principal at Huntington High School since 2024. He brings more than 17 years of educational leadership experience, having worked in DeSoto Parish and Tangipahoa Parish in various roles throughout his career. item.title: Ben Patillo named Business Person of the Year
item.description: The Bossier Chamber of Commerce named Ben Patillo, of Flying Heart Brewing & Pub, as its Business Person of the Year, highlighting Patillo’s leadership and dedication to both the business and the broader community. The award honors individuals who demonstrate strong leadership, perseverance and a commitment to supporting local growth and development.
